offering_description.value: Provides annuities, life insurance and retirement plan products to individuals and employers in the US. It funds these products with premiums and deposits, invests the money, and pays benefits and withdrawals over time.

primary_products.value: fixed and variable annuities; life insurance; group retirement plans

primary_services.value: retirement plan administration; asset management; institutional investment services

customer_segment.value: B2C: individuals saving for retirement and buying life insurance; B2B: employers sponsoring retirement plans, institutional investors

end_markets.value: retirement savings; life insurance; asset management

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: premiums on life and annuity contracts, investment income on policy reserves; commissions or management fees: fees on assets under management; service fees: fees for administering retirement plans
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes premiums and deposits from savers, invests them and pays benefits to policyholders; service provider: administers retirement plans for employers and plan participants

geography_served.value: US national: all US states, through independent and employer channels

specialization.value: related lines: life insurance, retirement annuities, group retirement plans and asset management

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: banks and broker-dealers that sell its annuities and life policies; agents / brokers: independent insurance agents and financial professionals; direct sales: sales teams serving employers and retirement plan sponsors
distribution_channels.category: partners / resellers; agents / brokers; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance products need state insurance department approval, variable annuities are overseen by the SEC and FINRA
